resourceCatalogBlock.title: Model & MCP Marketplace
resourceCatalogBlock.description: A responsive capability directory that switches between a model marketplace and MCP integrations without changing its page frame.
resourceCatalogBlock.previewModeBody: Use the frame navigation or these controls to inspect the two complete page states.
resourceCatalogBlock.guidanceBody: Use this block for a small, browsable inventory where people need to search, sort, and filter resources before selecting one.
resourceCatalogBlock.dataBoundaryBody: The block ships mock data only. Replace items and connect the selection action to your route or detail view in the consuming product.
